title: Surface shadcn widget vocabulary
description: The complete widget vocabulary for @rusl-labs/surface-shadcn: every widget this kit renders, presentation only, with no new wire shapes. Every widget's `$kind` is a surface.shadcn `$defs` URI. A top-level widget key always wins over the matching `options.*` key. Not widgets: dd/dt are view layout props, and input-group is renderer composition (the phone and money renderers already compose their own input groups).

binding.title: Value binding
binding.description: A dotted path on this node's data, a {{template}}, or a fixed literal. String shorthand: dotted path if no braces, template if {{…}} is present, literal otherwise.

path.description: Dotted path on this node's data.

image-dimension.description: Positive integer pixels for the HTML width/height attribute, or a binding resolving to that number. Missing dimensions are not invented.

input.title: Text input
input.description: Edits a string with the local shadcn Input. Top-level `placeholder`, `type`, and `autocomplete` win over `options.*`. `type` is the HTML input type (text, password, email, search, tel, url). Display renders the string as text.

email.title: Email
email.description: Edits an email string with the local shadcn Input (`type=email`). Display is a mailto: link. Top-level `placeholder` and `autocomplete` win over `options.*`.

media.title: Image media
media.description: Display-only image. `src` and `alt` are bindings (default: the string value or `url` / `alt` on a record). Width and height become HTML attributes and reserve aspect ratio. `fit` is CSS object-fit; `maxHeight` caps the rendered height. This kit supports images, not video/audio or uploads. The registered card view wraps a local shadcn Card. Top-level keys win over `options.*`.

currency-list.description: Restrict the currency picker to these ISO 4217 alphabetic codes, offered in this order (deduped, matched case-insensitively). Only known convertible codes are shown, always intersected with the money `currency` schema's enum. Omit for every convertible currency; [] offers none.

money.title: Money presentation
money.description: Presentation options for the canonical money renderer (an amount in minor units plus an ISO 4217 currency). Adds a currency-picker allowlist without changing the money wire value. Top-level `currencies` takes precedence over `options.currencies`. Offered codes are always intersected with the `currency` schema's enum; a `currency` const fixes the currency and hides the picker. Omit `currencies` for every convertible currency, or use [] to offer none. Filtering is presentation only: an already-stored currency outside the list stays visible and unchanged, and is never offered, converted, or cleared.

phone-format.description: Display text only. National uses the number's country; international is the default; e164 shows the canonical compact number. Storage and tel: links remain E.164.

tel.title: Telephone
tel.description: Edits a phone number as E.164. Input is a country combobox plus a national/international draft. Display is a tel: link. `format` is display text only (national, international, e164). `defaultCountry` is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. `countries` restricts the picker. `showCountry` defaults true. Top-level keys win over `options.*`.

textarea.title: Multiline text
textarea.description: Edits a string with the consuming application's local shadcn Textarea. Display mode renders the text without changing its wire value.

rows.description: Visible text rows; does not constrain the string length.

orientation.description: Layout axis for the shadcn primitive. Presentation only.

calendar-caption.description: shadcn Calendar month/year navigation. Display chrome only; the stored date is unchanged.

item-action.description: Add or Remove chrome. appearance label is text only (default); icon is the lucide icon with the label as the accessible name; both shows icon and text; tooltip is icon-only with the label in a Tooltip. icon: plus, trash, or x. label overrides addLabel / the default Remove text. Presentation only.

date.title: Date picker
date.description: Picks a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) with the local shadcn Calendar in a Popover. Display is localized plain text. `min` and `max` are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD bounds on the calendar. `captionLayout` selects month/year navigation. Top-level keys win over `options.*`.

datetime.title: Date-time picker
datetime.description: Picks a date and time; the wire value is an RFC 3339 local timestamp (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` or with seconds). `min` and `max` bound the calendar date. `showSeconds` adds seconds to the time control. `captionLayout` selects month/year navigation. Top-level keys win over `options.*`.

field.description: Property name or dotted path for the cell value.

label.description: Header text. Defaults to the field name.

sortable.description: Header click toggles display sort. Default true.

table.title: Data table
table.description: Array widget for an array of objects. Display is a shadcn Table; sort reorders the display only. Input uses the list editor with optional add/remove chrome. `columns` names the headers; omit to infer from row keys. `sort` is the initial display sort. Top-level keys win over `options.*`.

combobox.title: Combobox
combobox.description: Field widget for choosing one value from a long enum or suggested string set. Renders the local shadcn Command inside a Popover with type-ahead search; the stored value is the chosen option. Top-level `placeholder` wins over `options.placeholder`; `options.searchPlaceholder` and `options.emptyText` label the search field and the no-match state.

radio-group.title: Radio group
radio-group.description: Field widget for choosing one value from a small enum (roughly 2–7 options). Renders the local shadcn RadioGroup. Top-level `orientation` wins over `options.orientation`.

toggle-group.title: Toggle group
toggle-group.description: Field widget for choosing one value from a very small enum (roughly 2–5 options) shown as a shadcn ToggleGroup button row (the button-group style). Top-level `variant` wins over `options.variant`; `options.size` sets the button size.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: Binary on/off control. Use on a boolean, or on an enum with two values. `on` is the wire value when checked; `off` when unchecked. Top-level keys win over `options.*`. Defaults: boolean true/false; two-value enum uses the second member as on and the first as off.

code.title: Code editor
code.description: Opt-in CodeMirror editor. Open objects (additionalProperties maps) default to a JSON textarea; set this widget to use a highlighted editor. Object schemas store a JSON object on the wire; string schemas store the source text. Top-level `language` (alias `format`) wins over `options.*`. Common languages: json, javascript, typescript, html, css, markdown, yaml. Unknown names fall back to plain text.

list.title: Item list
list.description: Array widget: renders each array item as a stacked shadcn list row rather than a table. Top-level `marker` wins over `options.marker` and selects the item marker.

carousel.title: Carousel
carousel.description: Array widget: renders array items — typically media — in the local shadcn Carousel, one slide at a time. Presentation only; the array order stays the wire order. Top-level `orientation` wins over `options.orientation`; `options.loop` wraps past the ends.

accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.description: Object/section widget: renders each immediate child section or property as a shadcn Accordion panel. Top-level `type` wins over `options.type` (`single` or `multiple` open panels); `options.collapsible` lets a `single` accordion close its open panel.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.description: Object/section widget: wraps the child fields in one shadcn Collapsible disclosure. Top-level `defaultOpen` wins over `options.defaultOpen`; `options.label` sets the trigger text.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Field chrome: wraps a field's normal control with a shadcn Tooltip hint and does not replace the control or its stored value. Top-level `text` wins over `options.text` for the hint content; `options.side` places the tooltip.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Object/section chrome: draws a shadcn Separator between children and renders no field value. Top-level `orientation` wins over `options.orientation`; `options.label` prints an optional inline caption.
